label: UNAME_R
argv: ( uname -r ); rc=$?; printf '\nWRAPPER_RC_UNAME_R=%s\n' "$rc"; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then echo DONE_REMOTE_UNAME_R; else echo FAIL_REMOTE_UNAME_R; fi
